title: Climate risk is moving to the boardroom as companies rethink resilience
summary: At the Mint Sustainability Summit, industry leaders said adapting to extreme weather is now a business imperative, with the cost of resilience far lower than the losses from climate disruption.

title: Centre plans to allow govt-approved private labs to test electricity meters
summary: The proposal to allow government-authorized private laboratories to test electricity meters aims to boost consumer confidence, reduce billing disputes and support India's smart meter rollout.

title: Near-zero power prices threaten renewable energy economics
summary: As renewable generation outpaces daytime demand distribution companies (discoms) increasingly offload surplus green power on exchanges at prices well below procurement costs.

title: Centre plans bulk drug PLI scheme revamp, says pharmaceuticals secretary Manoj Joshi
summary: India's reliance on imports for certain critical classes of drugs creates strategic vulnerabilities by exposing the pharmaceutical supply chain to external disruptions and geopolitical risks.
